_about: SAME-1 brief 1's HAND CLASSES (2026-11-20), read first by scripts/sameness-census.mjs :: classOf, which falls back to its rule. Key: a stored source path (indices folded to []); or, for a sentence composed at display, `COMPOSED@<heading> ~ <module>`; a key with ` ~ <top sentence>` after it splits one composed slot by its commonest sentence. `why` names the symbol that chooses the sentence; `empty state` marks a line printed where the place has nothing (a DM still reads it again). The seed of brief 2's register.
